Benefit

Pore Wash

Pop Up Mob launched Pore Wash as the consumer-facing debut of Benefit's POREcare collection, transforming a car wash–inspired concept into a bold, street-level skincare moment that started in NYC and scaled to London.

BeautyMarch 2023NYC, New York + London, UK100% Experiential
The Story
NYC + London

Created to introduce the POREcare collection in a way that felt unmistakably Benefit, Pore Wash reimagined the ritual of cleansing through a car wash–inspired takeover, playful, high-impact, and impossible to miss. First launched in New York, the activation used oversized wash cues and cheeky signage to turn pore care into a public spectacle, before adapting the same concept for London with a tone that felt native to the city. Pop Up Mob then developed a global toolkit, allowing markets across Asia to translate the idea with consistency while tailoring execution locally. What began as a city-driven launch became a cohesive international rollout, keeping the POREcare story clear, visible, and true to Benefit's personality wherever it traveled.
